responsibilities: Developed and maintained Anaplan models for workforce and financial planning.

Supported internal and external HR audits.

Conducted sentiment analysis and provided recommendations for service improvement.
Supported cross-functional research teams with bioinformatics and literature analysis.
Conducted quality checks on data sets to maintain consistency.

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience Anaplan SME | Envalior India Pvt. Ltd, Pune | May 2023 – May 2025
────────────────────────────────────────────
Developed and maintained Anaplan models for workforce and financial planning. • Implemented ALM best practices for controlled model deployment and version management. • Built dashboards and UX pages for HR and Finance teams to visualize workforce metrics. • Automated monthly reporting processes reducing manual data handling by 40%. • Performed model validation and ensured consistency across modules and hierarchies. • Partnered with Finance, HR, and IT to improve planning accuracy and process efficiency. • Supported forecasting and capacity planning initiatives using Anaplan’s predictive features. • Conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for model releases. • Created documentation and knowledge transfer guides for model users. • Trained new users on Anaplan UX dashboards and best practices. • Completed Anaplan Level 1 and Level 2 certifications, strengthening solution design skills. HR Specialist (Dutch) | Envalior India Pvt. Ltd, Pune | Jan 2022 – April 2023
Oversaw Dutch HR operations including payroll, compliance, and employee documentation. • Built HR analytics dashboards for tracking attendance, attrition, and workforce distribution. • Designed process documentation improving operational efficiency by 20%. • Coordinated Dutch visa and employee relocation processes. • Partnered with finance and legal teams for audit readiness and compliance accuracy. • Delivered regular HR reports to management to support strategic planning. • Supported implementation of HRIS enhancements and automation. • Assisted with employee engagement initiatives for Dutch offices. HR Support Officer (Dutch) | DSM Shared Services, Hyderabad | Jan 2021 – Dec 2021
Managed employee lifecycle processes for Dutch business units. • Conducted onboarding sessions and delivered Dutch cultural orientation. • Processed HR transactions ensuring accuracy within HRMS system. • Supported internal and external HR audits. • Collaborated with Dutch HR Business Partners for policy alignment and process improvement.
Dutch Data Analyst | Sprinkler Solutions, New Delhi | Apr 2020 – Jul 2020
Analyzed Dutch client feedback for product and service performance. • Conducted sentiment analysis and provided recommendations for service improvement. • Supported data reporting by categorizing and translating Dutch customer inputs. • Collaborated with client teams to summarize insights and performance trends. Scientific Analyst | Molecular Connections Pvt. Ltd, Bangalore | May 2017 – May 2019
Extracted biomedical data and analyzed scientific articles to support research studies. • Conducted quality checks on data sets to maintain consistency. • Supported cross-functional research teams with bioinformatics and literature analysis. • Documented project outcomes and contributed to data accuracy improvements.
